en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a lush garden scene with palm trees, flowering plants, and a central fountain jetting water upward. The front side is labeled 'Bad Pyrmont. Palmengarten.' The reverse side has printed text mentioning 'Herzbad Pyrmont' and 'Deutschlands schönster Kurpark,' along with the heading 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.' There is space for a message, address, and a stamp.
